detail.longDescription: 🎙️ Ubuntu’s new AI-powered dictation tool Myna isn’t officially ready, but you can give it an early test. ｢ Canonical has added the Myna orchestrator snap and a pair of speech-recognition AI models to the Snap Store recently, and made its new desktop Myna Settings tool available to test from a PPA ｣ https://www. omgubuntu.co.uk/2026/09/ubuntu -myna-ai-install # Ubuntu # Myna # AI # opensource
